brief:
Democracy for the Arab World Now filed formal sanctions referrals with the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Norway, and Australia on Tuesday, calling for penalties against former and current commanders of the Israeli army unit overseeing what the group characterizes as a starvation campaign against Palestinians in Gaza since October 7, 2023.

The advocacy organization submitted the referrals to five governments' authorities, according to DAWN, naming military officials responsible for administering Israel's policies affecting food supplies in the enclave.
dek: (Washington, D.C., September 24, 2026) - The former and current commanders of the Israeli army unit administering and implementing Israel’s campaign of starvation against Palestinians in Gaza since October 7, 2023 should be sanctioned, said Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN) in filing formal sanctions referrals with the governments of the U.S., U.K., Canada, Norway and Australia today.
title: DAWN urges US, UK, allies to sanction Israeli commanders over Gaza starvation
